name: Valley of Hamongog
line: The Valley of Hamon-gog is a burial valley in Israel, east of the Sea, where God says Gog and all his hordes will be buried after He defeats them.

moments.title: A burial place for Gog
moments.text: God says He will give Gog a burial place in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the Sea. Gog and all his hordes will be buried there, so it will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.

moments.title: Cleansing the land
moments.text: God says men will be employed to pass through the land and bury the invaders who remain. Anyone who sees a human bone will set up a pillar next to it, until the gravediggers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
